name: girder
desc: Girder. Stationary object on which cargo may be piled.

name: vertgirder
desc: Vertical Girder. Stationary object on which cargo may be piled.

name: conveyorright
desc: Right Conveyor. Moves cargo to the right.

name: conveyorleft
desc: Left Conveyor. Moves cargo to the left.

name: pipeup
desc: Upward Pipe. Sucks cargo from the bottom to the top.

name: pipedown
desc: Downward Pipe. Sucks cargo from the top to the bottom.

name: dozerright
desc: Right Dozer. Pushes cargo to the right, is also affected by gravity.

name: dozerleft
desc: Left Dozer. Pushes cargo to the left, is also affected by gravity.

name: rampright
desc: Left Ramp. Dozers climb up and down ramps, cargo slides down them.

name: rampleft
desc: Right Ramp. Dozers climb up and down ramps, cargo slides down them.

name: flipsign
desc: Turn Signal. Place a turn signal above a dozer's path to make it reverse.

name: copierup
desc: Upward Copier. An item of cargo placed below it is copied above.

name: copier
desc: Downward Copier. An item of cargo placed on top of it is copied below.

name: winchup
desc: Upward Winch. Lifts an item of cargo from directly below it to directly above, and thenbecomes a Downward Winch.

name: winchdown
desc: Downward Winch. Lowers an item of cargo from directly above it to directly below, and thenbecomes an Upward Winch.

name: gate
desc: Gate. Compares the number value of the cargo on top to that of the cargo below. If the top cargo is larger,it rolls off to the right. If it's smaller or equal, it rolls off to the left.

name: packer
desc: Packer. The value of the cargo on the green input wires are added together (in hex, modulo 16)to create a new cargo on the red output wire. (The input cargoes are destroyed.)

name: unpacker
desc: Unpacker. The value of the right green-input cargo is subtracted from the value of the left (in hex,modulo 16) to create a new cargo on the red output wire. (The input cargoes are destroyed.)

name: antisign
desc: Anti Sign. Any blocks touching this block (including diagonally adjacent) may not be used by theplayer when solving the level.
'A' Barrel. (A is equal to '10' in hexadecimal.)
'B' Barrel. (B is equal to '11' in hexadecimal.)
'C' Barrel. (C is equal to '12' in hexadecimal.)
'D' Barrel. (D is equal to '13' in hexadecimal.)
'E' Barrel. (E is equal to '14' in hexadecimal.)
'F' Barrel. (F is equal to '15' in hexadecimal.)

name: randombarrel
desc: Random Barrel. Is assigned a random value when the program starts. (If placed on acopier, the Barrel remains random and the copier generates random Barrels.)

name: doorkey
desc: Door Key. If one side of the Key is covered and the other is empty (vertically or horizontally), a Dooror Trapdoor appears on the empty side, until the other side becomes empty again.

name: furnace
desc: Furnace. Destroys all cargo that touches it.

name: trapdoor
desc: Trapdoor. Generated and destroyed by Door Keys, can be used independently as barriers.

name: door
desc: Door. Generated and destroyed by Door Keys, can be used independently as barriers.
'A' Crate. (A is equal to '10' in hexadecimal.)
'B' Crate. (B is equal to '11' in hexadecimal.)
'C' Crate. (C is equal to '12' in hexadecimal.)
'D' Crate. (D is equal to '13' in hexadecimal.)
'E' Crate. (E is equal to '14' in hexadecimal.)
'F' Crate. (F is equal to '15' in hexadecimal.)

name: randomcrate
desc: Random Crate. Is assigned a random value when the program starts. (If placed on acopier, the crate remains random and the copier generates random crates.)

name: matchoff
desc: Target Matcher. Turns green if the crates above and below it match, red if not.

name: matchgreen
desc: Target Matcher. Turns green if the crates above and below it match, red if not.

name: matchred
desc: Target Matcher. Turns green if the crates above and below it match, red if not.

name: fixedblank
desc: Locked Space. Becomes normal empty space when the level starts - can be used to mark off areas where youdon't want the player to build.
